title: A focused cargo test filter that matches zero tests passes silently; the launcher should name it
outcome: When a focused `cargo test` run is given several filter arguments and one of them matches no test, the launcher's summary names that filter as matching zero tests, so a coverage gap is visible in the run's result instead of passing silently. Exit status and pass/fail semantics stay unchanged.
acceptance: A test runs the focused launcher with two filters, one of which matches no test, and shows the summary names the zero-match filter while the run's pass/fail result is unchanged.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
